palette.notes: terminal green (#2ED9A0-ish) for code/hacker beats, alert red (#E4382E) for danger/lock/threat beats, near-black bg (#0A0C0F) throughout; host hoodie is white/cream, framed by a red graphic (looks like a red hand-print/logo) behind him

headline.size_rel: large, ~2-3 words per line, left-aligned or centered depending on beat

caption.size_rel: medium, bottom-third, white fill no stroke (relies on dark bg for contrast) — occasional highlighted word in accent color

layout.host_pos: full-bleed vertical talking head, centered, chest-up; recurring branded graphic behind (red hand-print) as a bumper/sting element between segments
layout.safe_zones: top ~10% reserved for small pill/label tags (e.g. speaker name, 'source' tag), bottom ~15% for captions
layout.caption_pos: lower-third, centered, 2-4 words at a time, animates in per-word

transitions: number ticker / counter animation on stats
grid of red/white squares filling in for 'compromise count' beats

themeable: accent color (swap red for channel color)
accent2 terminal-green (swap per topic, e.g. code color)
